identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase 1/2 Study of VS-7375 in Patients With KRAS G12D-Mutated Solid Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 1/2, Open-label Study of VS-7375, a KRAS G12D (ON/OFF) Inhibitor, as Monotherapy and in Combination, in Patients With Advanced KRAS G12D-Mutated Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study will assess the safety and efficacy of VS-7375 alone and in combination in patients with advanced solid tumors harboring a KRAS G12D-mutation.

armGroups.label: VS-7375 Monotherapy Dose Escalation
armGroups.description: To characterize the safety and tolerability of escalating doses of VS-7375 as monotherapy and to determine the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2Ds) in patients with advanced solid tumors harboring KRAS G12D mutation.

armGroups.label: VS-7375 Monotherapy Dose Expansion - PDAC
armGroups.description: To evaluate the efficacy of VS-7375 at the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2Ds) in patients with metastatic PDAC harboring KRAS G12D-mutation.

armGroups.label: VS-7375 Monotherapy Dose Expansion - NSCLC
armGroups.description: To evaluate the efficacy of VS-7375 at the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2Ds) in patients with metastatic NSCLC harboring KRAS G12D-mutation.

armGroups.label: VS-7375 Monotherapy Dose Expansion - Solid Tumors
armGroups.description: To evaluate the efficacy of VS-7375 at the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2Ds) in patients with metastatic solid tumors harboring KRAS G12D-mutation.

armGroups.label: VS-7375 + Cetuximab Dose Escalation
armGroups.description: To characterize the safety and tolerability of escalating doses of VS-7375 in combination with cetuximab and to determine the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2Ds) in patients with advanced or metastatic PDAC, BTC, CRC harboring KRAS G12D-mutation.

armGroups.label: VS-7375 + Carboplatin/Pemetrexed/Pembrolizumab Dose Escalation
armGroups.description: To characterize the safety and tolerability of escalating doses of VS-7375 in combination with carboplatin/pemetrexed/pembrolizumab and to determine the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2Ds) in patients with metastatic NSCLC harboring KRAS G12D-mutation.

armGroups.label: VS-7375 + Gemcitabine/Nab-Paclitaxel Dose Escalation
armGroups.description: To characterize the safety and tolerability of escalating doses of VS-7375 in combination with gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel and to determine the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2Ds) in patients with advanced or metastatic PDAC harboring KRAS G12D-mutation.

armGroups.label: VS-7375 + Pembrolizumab Dose Escalation
armGroups.description: To characterize the safety and tolerability of escalating doses of VS-7375 in combination with pembrolizumab and to determine the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2Ds) in patients with advanced or metastatic NSCLC harboring KRAS G12D-mutation.

armGroups.label: VS-7375 + Defactinib Dose Escalation
armGroups.description: To characterize the safety and tolerability of escalating doses of VS-7375 in combination with defactinib and to determine the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2Ds) in patients with advanced or metastatic NSCLC harboring KRAS G12D-mutation.

armGroups.label: VS-7375 + Cetuximab Dose Expansion
armGroups.description: To evaluate the efficacy of VS-7375 in combination with cetuximab at the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2Ds) in patients with with advanced or metastatic CRC harboring KRAS G12D-mutation.

armGroups.label: VS-7375 + Carboplatin/Pemetrexed/Pembrolizumab Dose Expansion
armGroups.description: To evaluate the efficacy of VS-7375 in combination with carboplatin/pemetrexed/pembrolizumab at the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2Ds) in patients with metastatic NSCLC harboring KRAS G12D-mutation.

armGroups.label: VS-7375 + Gemcitabine/Nab-Paclitaxel Dose Expansion
armGroups.description: To evaluate the efficacy of VS-7375 in combination with gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel at the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2Ds) in patients with metastatic PDAC harboring KRAS G12D-mutation.

armGroups.label: VS-7375 + Midazolam and Repaglinide Drug-Drug Interaction
armGroups.description: To assess the drug-drug interaction of VS-7375 in combination with midazolam and repaglinide in patients with advanced or metastatic PDAC, NSCLC, and CRC harboring a KRAS G12D mutation.

armGroups.label: VS-7375 Serial Biopsy
armGroups.description: To characterize the preliminary anti-cancer activity of VS-7375 in participants with metastatic PDAC who have received 2 or 3 prior therapies, correlated with biopsy-obtained biomarkers.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Part A: To characterize the safety, tolerability, and AE profile of escalating doses of VS-7375
primaryOutcomes.description:
To characterize the safety, tolerability, and AE profile of escalating doses of VS-7375 as monotherapy administered on a daily oral schedule in participants with any KRAS G12D-mutated solid tumor who have received 1 to 3 lines of prior systemic therapy.

Proportion/number of participants with AEs, TEAEs, TRAEs, SAEs, and DLTs; and abnormal vital signs, physical examination, ECG parameters, ECOG PS, clinical laboratory results; and dose interruptions/reductions.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Part A: To identify the MTD or MFD
primaryOutcomes.description:
To identify the MTD or MFD using a BOIN design and recommend a dose for subsequent studies of VS-7375 as monotherapy on a daily oral schedule in participants with any KRAS G12D-mutated solid tumor who have received 1 to 3 lines of prior systemic therapy.

Proportion/number of participants with DLTs during the DLT assessment period (C1D1 through C1D21).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Part B: To evaluate the preliminary anticancer activity of the optimal VS-7375 regimen
primaryOutcomes.description:
To evaluate the efficacy of the optimal VS-7375 regimen identified from Part A in participants with metastatic KRAS G12D-mutated PDAC who have received 1 line of prior systemic therapy (cohort B1), NSCLC who have received 1 or 2 lines of prior systemic therapy (cohort B2), and other solid tumors who have received 1 or 2 lines of prior systemic therapy (cohort B3).

Cohorts B1 and B2:

Confirmed ORR by Investigator assessment per RECIST v1.1 .

Cohort B3:

Confirmed ORR by blinded independent central review (BICR) per RECIST v1.1.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Part C: To characterize the safety, tolerability, and AE profile of VS-7375 in combination regimens.
primaryOutcomes.description:
To characterize the safety, tolerability, and adverse event profile of VS-7375 in combination with:

* Cetuximab in participants with advanced/metastatic PDAC after 1 prior systemic therapy, locally advanced/metastatic BTC after 1-2 prior systemic therapies, or metastatic CRC after 1-3 prior systemic therapies (C1)
* Carboplatin, pembrolizumab, and pemetrexed in previously untreated metastatic NSCLC (C2)
* Gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel in locally advanced/metastatic PDAC after 1 prior systemic therapy (C3)
* Pembrolizumab in locally advanced/metastatic NSCLC after up to 3 prior systemic therapies (C4)
* Defactinib in metastatic PDAC or metastatic CRC (C5)

Proportion/number of participants with AEs, TEAEs, TRAEs, SAEs, DLTs, and dose interruptions/reductions.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From enrollment to the end of treatment; an average of 9 months

primaryOutcomes.measure: Part C: To identify a recommended dose for subsequent studies of combination dosed VS-7375.
primaryOutcomes.description:
To identify a recommended dose for subsequent studies of combination dosed VS-7375.

Proportion/number of participants with DLTs during the DLT assessment period (through end of Cycle 1).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Part D: To determine the preliminary anticancer activity of the optimal regimen of VS-7375 as identified in Part C
primaryOutcomes.description:
To determine the efficacy of the optimal regimen of VS-7375 identified in Part C:

* In combination with cetuximab in participants with metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma who have received 1 to 3 prior lines of systemic therapy (cohort D1)
* In combination with carboplatin, pembrolizumab, and pemetrexed in participants with previously untreated metastatic NSCLC (cohort D2)
* In combination with gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel in participants with previously untreated metastatic PDAC (cohort D3)

Confirmed ORR by Investigator assessment, per RECIST v1.1 .

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Individuals ≥18 years of age.
* Agreement to sign and date an informed consent form (ICF) approved by the Institutional Review Board (IRB)/Independent Ethics Committee (IEC).
* Histologic or cytologic evidence of locally advanced unresectable or metastatic solid tumor harboring a KRAS G12D mutation.
* Measurable disease according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1.
* Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0 or 1
* Adequate organ function
* Adequate cardiac function
* Recovered from all AEs due to previous therapies to Grade ≤1 or baseline
* Agreement to use highly effective contraception

Key Exclusion Criteria:

* Underwent major surgical procedure as defined by the Investigator, other than for diagnosis, within 4 weeks prior to Cycle 1 Day 1
* Receipt of chemotherapy, targeted therapy, or radiotherapy (excluding palliative radiation) within 4 weeks or 5 half-lives, whichever is shorter, or immunotherapy within 4 weeks prior to Cycle 1 Day 1.
* Treatment with any investigational drug at least 4 weeks or 5 half-lives, whichever is shorter, prior to Cycle 1 Day 1.
* History of treatment with direct RAS inhibitors.
* Symptomatic, untreated, or actively progressing known central nervous system (CNS) metastases.
* Inability to swallow oral medications.
* Evidence or history of uncontrolled, clinically significant hematological, renal, hepatic, endocrine, pulmonary, gastrointestinal, cardiovascular, psychiatric, coagulation, neurologic, dermatologic, autoimmune, or allergic disease.
* Individuals who are pregnant or breastfeeding.
